typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Payment Related Breaks} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		{Payment Related $ Value} as string,
		{Trade Related $ Value} as string,
		{Trade Related Breaks} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Payment_Related_Breaks as double,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Title__LinkTitle_ as string,
		Payment_Related___Value as double,
		Trade_Related___Value as double,
		Trade_Related_Breaks as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Payment_Related_Breaks = {Payment Related Breaks},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Title__LinkTitle_ = {Title (Title)},
		Payment_Related___Value = {Payment Related $ Value},
		Trade_Related___Value = {Trade Related $ Value},
		Trade_Related_Breaks = {Trade Related Breaks}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
